alt: 草坡上的兔子警覺望向遠處狐狸，地下剖面可見連通不同出口的三處備用洞穴與食物。
scene_prompt: A single clever rabbit on a grassy hillside pauses alertly beside its home while a distant fox is visible far away. A clean natural cutaway of the earth reveals three separate sheltered burrows, each containing dry grass and a small carrot stash, connected by distinct escape tunnels with different exits. Emphasize several prepared safe alternatives for the same rabbit. No extra rabbits, no labels, no arrows, coherent simple tunnel geography.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, natural or timeless setting appropriate to the described scene, all people original. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
